note:
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Wooded and open loops north of Black Rock Pond, within walking distance of the beach and fishing pond; no site is on the water. No pets or alcohol in the campground. --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + 2017 map + imagery: $17/$27 and the $10 electric surcharge confirmed; 78 sites, nine new 50-amp electric+water sites (hookups written), max 35 ft with pull-throughs; showers, flush toilets, water, dump; 2026 season May 22-Oct 12 written; pin is ~800 m off; park phone found; note trimmed.
flags: PIN: stored 41.6469,-73.0967 is on a park road by a small building south of Black Rock Pond, about 800 m SSE of the campground. The loops (main road, Horseshoe, Gypsy and Beach Circles) sit on imagery around 41.6536,-73.1004 (OSM's campground node 41.65385,-73.10037 agrees). Recommend moving the pin to 41.6536,-73.1004 (elevation may change with it).
PHONE: the stored 877-668-2267 is the statewide ReserveAmerica line, not the park's. ctparks.com lists the park's own number as (860) 283-8088 (DEEP's page for this park).

HOOKUPS: ReserveAmerica's campground description still says electric and water hook-ups are not available, but its own notice and the per-site details show the nine upgraded sites as 50-amp with water, and ctparks.com prices 'Campsite with electric and water' at $27/$37. The description text is stale.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the 2017 map and imagery put the nearest sites (Beach Circle 52-57, and 58/59) about 80-110 m from the pond's north arm, through trees. No site is within 50 m on open ground.

SITE COUNT: ctparks says 78 campsites and '30 RV/Tent Sites'; ReserveAmerica lists 64 sites plus 4 cabins (28 standard non-electric, 9 standard electric, 13 popup/tent, 14 tent-only); the RA description says 75. count 78 written from the park page.

BOOKING (inherited, not written): ctparks.com/camping and the RA notice say that after Labor Day standard sites are walk-in Sunday-Thursday nights, with advance reservations for Friday and Saturday nights. This fits the inherited fcfs 'after_cutoff' loosely; the reviewer may want a booking.note for it.
